hello-world.README.md:
# hello-world

This project has a shared JavaScript core, a Node CLI and a browser UI.
Install the exact external dependency with `npm ci`.
Run `npm start` with one JSON request on stdin.
From the ACE repository, run `node applications/serve.mjs /absolute/path/to/project` and open the printed URL.
Run `ace app test . --image ace-applications:local --output ../result --store ../history`.
See ace-app.json, dependencies.lock.json and package-lock.json for pinned dependencies.

tictactoe.web/index.html: TicTacToe
tictactoe.web/app.js:
'use strict';
let moves=[];const cells=[];function render(){const r=ACEHandle({moves});for(let i=0;i<9;i++){cells[i].textContent=r.board[i]==='.'?'':r.board[i];cells[i].disabled=r.board[i]!=='.'||r.status!=='playing';}document.getElementById('result').textContent=r.status==='playing'?r.next+' to play':r.status==='draw'?'Draw':r.status+' wins';}for(let i=0;i<9;i++){const b=document.createElement('button');b.setAttribute('aria-label','Cell '+(i+1));b.addEventListener('click',()=>{moves.push(i);render();});cells.push(b);document.getElementById('board').append(b);}document.getElementById('reset').addEventListener('click',()=>{moves=[];render();});render();
